courses.overview: 從Aurora 的 Xeon Max、Ponte Vecchio 與資料路徑延伸至兩個相近領域；共用架構不代表相同數值、許可權或安全保證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend aurora xeon max, ponte vecchio and data paths to two neighboring areas; shared architectures do not imply equal values, privileges or guarantees.

related.whyEn: Both have CPU/GPU and system-network hierarchies
related.transfer: 皆有 CPU/GPU 與系統網路的層次
related.transferEn: Both have CPU/GPU and system-network hierarchies
related.difference: Intel GPU 與 AMD GCD 架構和軟體不同
related.differenceEn: Intel GPU and AMD GCD hardware/software differ

place.name: Oak Ridge 公開科學運算城市代表點
place.nameEn: Oak Ridge public scientific-computing city reference
place.coordinateScope: 城市中心近似座標，僅作公開技術脈絡的地理代表點，不是機構地址、裝置位置、登入位置或參訪入口。研究與開源合作分散全球，並非本課所有技術都在此發明或部署。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate city-center coordinates for public technical context, not institutional addresses, equipment, login locations or visitor entrances. Research and open collaboration are global; this does not locate every invention or deployment.

practice: 畫出本課與「Frontier 超級電腦架構」共用的資料／元件介面；以「皆有 CPU/GPU 與系統網路的層次」指出能保留的條件。
針對「Intel GPU 與 AMD GCD 架構和軟體不同」改寫一個實驗，列出新增的輸入、單位與可辨別觀測。
將本課量化例移到新情境：沿用有根據的公式、重新指定假設並標記不能移轉的數值。
practiceEn: Draw shared data/component interfaces with frontier supercomputer architecture; use "Both have CPU/GPU and system-network hierarchies" to identify retained conditions.
For "Intel GPU and AMD GCD hardware/software differ", redesign one experiment with new inputs, units and discriminating observations.
Transfer the quantitative example: retain justified formulas, respecify assumptions and identify nontransferable values.

courses.summary: Aurora 超級電腦架構從Aurora 的 Xeon Max、Ponte Vecchio 與資料路徑連結介面、資料與驗收。地圖是公開研究城市的近似代表點，不代表所有工具在此製造或部署。
courses.summaryEn: Aurora supercomputer architecture connects interfaces, data and acceptance through aurora xeon max, ponte vecchio and data paths. Maps are approximate public research-city references, not claims of manufacturing or deployment.
courses.connection: 從「異質節點」到「系統驗收」，將技術定義與可反駁驗證對接。
courses.connectionEn: Connect heterogeneous nodes to system acceptance, pairing technical definitions and falsifiable validation.

history.title: 從公開架構到原創教學模型
history.titleEn: From public architecture to original teaching models
history.text: Aurora 公開指南拆分 CPU、GPU 與連線層次；課程將規格和假想陣列計算分別標示。
history.textEn: Aurora public guides separate CPUs, GPUs and links; specifications and hypothetical array calculations are labeled separately.

history.year: 科教與協作 / Education and collaboration
history.title: 跨機構、跨版本的工程驗證
history.titleEn: Engineering checks across institutions and versions
history.text: 本課由原始檔案與官方介面出發，使用自製架構、算例和合成資料；城市標記只協助理解協作脈絡，不聲稱可參訪、可登入或具有現場操作許可權。
history.textEn: The course starts from original documents and official interfaces, using original architectures, examples and synthetic data. City markers provide collaboration context, not visits, logins or operational privileges.
